attempts.summary: Configured a persistent, key-only SSH ingestion path from node2’s uploader account to node1’s ingest account. Each submission becomes a separate atomic receipt. Arbitrary commands, shells, PTYs, and forwarding are denied. Existing receipts and the sample batch were preserved. Both nodes passed sequential restart and recovery verification while remaining on CentOS 5.11 with kernel 2.6.18-398.el5.
